If topics are not published at the same rate, you could increase "sync_queue_size" and/or "topic_queue_size" parameters (current=10 and 10 respectively).

Ajusting topic_queue_size (10) and sync_queue_size (10) can also help for better synchronization if framerates and/or delays are different. If topics are not published at the same rate, you could increase "sync_queue_size" and/or "topic_queue_size" parameters (current=10 and 10 respectively).
